notes.title: Version 2.1.4
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.4:
- Level 7 doesn't open up level 8 any more (to introduce concept of stand-alone optional level earlier). 
- Fixed a bug preventing game from switching to windowed mode

notes.title: Version 2.1.3
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.3:
- Burt has decided to change his name to Bella
- Made Ash Island level background alpha darker
- Put a ! block on the flag in level 30 so you have to split Kells up to get all coins and perfect it
- Renamed level 12 to Drop the Flag
- Improved Layout of level 12
- Increased Kell entrance speed on Level 33
- Increased speed of Kells entry on C30
- Fixed some typo in TIPS 
- BUGFIX: Fixed minor graphical issue on tree of Snow Island
- BUGFIX: Fixed issue where sound effects start at full volume on a clean install
- BUGFIX: Fixed issue when level line goes slightly over on Kell Island
- BUGFIX: Fixed slight issue on Credits screen (space text is a little too low)

notes.title: Version 2.1.2
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.2:
- Fixed bug where sound effects defaulted to highest volume for new installs. Now the default is 3 blocks as intended.

notes.title: Version 2.1.1
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.1:
- Fixed bug where under certain circumstances the game would crash when starting a new profile.

notes.title: Version 2.1.0
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.0:
- Added mood graphics to visualise when a kell is happy, sad or angry. 
- Kell moods are now clearer in-game and on Kellective screen and team selection screen.
- Sad and Angry Kells are affected more when taking damage. 
- Adjusted mood tolerance to improve mood changes and make them more random between Kells. 
- Zombie Kells how have red eyes in-game. 
- Added "purple riddles" that provide hints for locating Purple Coins.
- Fixed a big on Special Kappa level that prevented it from being perfectable. 
- Level 23 is now called "Kellapse" and is now more challenging (only DOWN arrows allowed).
- Improved particle effects added to all Kell Island levels.
- Fixed bug with click boundary on Profile Select screen.
- Darkened Background alpha for all Area 42 levels.

notes.title: Version 2.0.4
notes.notes:
Version 2.0.4:
- Fixed bug where it was sometimes possible to cheat death by bypassing the Total Rekell Game Over screen.
- Fixed bug where Total Rekell resurrected more Kells than it was supposed to.
- Fixed bug in end-end game (that no one will ever reach) where Area 42 levels didn't reveal properly.
